verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents a RESTful API, SDKs and an llms.txt documentation index, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file is a documentation index, not an API specification, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
